name: Chicken Marsala (Creamy Mushroom Marsala Braise)
method: cream braise (chicken browned, then simmered in marsala-mushroom cream sauce)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 large chicken breasts (300g/10oz each), cut in half horizontally (or 4 thighs)
2 eschalots (US: shallots), peeled and cut into 1cm squares
1 tbsp finely chopped parsley, for garnish (optional)
unmapped: marsala wine (no board home - grep miss in commodities.json; a genuinely-absent ingredient for the pricer-lane exercise)
why: Creamy mushroom marsala braise: chicken browned then returned and simmered in a marsala-stock-cream pan sauce. Published 524 cal / 36g protein / 16g carbs per serving - middle of the band, well under both ceilings, strong protein. Structurally low-carb (meat + mushrooms + cream, only 1/4 cup flour to dredge). Carries one genuinely-absent signature ingredient (marsala wine) which is a FEATURE for this proving run - it exercises the new-commodity queue. Medium confidence on LANE FIT: RTE labels the method 'Pan-fry' and it leans toward a saute-with-pan-sauce; I judge it a cream braise (explicitly in-scope) but flagging so the selector can rule if the skillet-saute worker has better claim.
